desc.zh-Hans: 更新了新开通线路：长春轨道交通7号线（2026年8月26日开通），长春轨道交通5号线（2026 年9月 28日开通）；并更改了一个车站名称（2025年8月，职业学院站随新版线路图更名为职业技术大学站，英文名改为Zhiye Jishu Daxue)
desc.en: Added newly opened lines: Changchun Rail Transit Line 7 (opened on August 26, 2026) and Changchun Rail Transit Line 5 (opened on September 28, 2026); also updated one station name (In August 2025, Zhiye Xueyuan Station was renamed Zhiye Jishu Daxue Station in line with the new network map).

updateHistory.reason: 新增长春图（修复 #39 提到的问题）
Update English translation and add new stations
Update all station English names to lowercase Pinyin and add Line 6
Route Map in all stations of Changchun Rail Transit was updated on September 28, 2025.

The route map information of the existing project is incomplete. Changchun Rail Transit Line 7 opened on August 26, 2026, and Changchun Rail Transit Line 5 opened on September 28, 2026. Revisions will be made and information on soon-to-open lines will be added based on the official website of Changchun Rail Transit, the new network maps posted inside trains and on station platforms, and relevant releases from official media.
